summary: Iteration 34: Validated Holding Action Score (HAS) feature end-to-end. Backend: all 41 unit tests pass + 12 new API integration tests pass against /api/insights/v3-portfolio. Frontend: V3PortfolioInsights component renders Avg HAS tile (63/100), 25 fund rows with HAS pills, filter chips with counts matching API (All·26, Exit·0, Switch·3, Trim·4, Review·0, Add·0), expandable Portfolio-aware panels showing OIS/ADS/TFS pills + reason line + guardrail. Filter narrowing works (TRIM→4, SWITCH→3). Sorting by HAS action priority verified. High-quality protection guardrail verified — 0 EXITs in portfolio.

minor.issue: Endpoint takes ~5s due to synchronous compute_portfolio_intelligence; consider caching/async if user-perceived latency becomes an issue
401/429 observed on rapid back-to-back loads from frontend during initial authoring of session — likely rate-limit or CSRF/double-fetch; not a blocker

issues: DialogContent missing DialogTitle accessibility warning logged in console (a11y, not user-visible)

action_items: Optional: investigate spurious 401/429 on first-load when navigating Insights → Fund & Overlap Insights (race between auth-bootstrap and v3-portfolio fetch).

Optional: portfolio sample for priyankamantri does not contain any debt/liquid funds — debt category tuning is fully covered by unit tests but not yet validated against live data; consider seeding a debt holding to exercise the live path.
critical_code_review_comments: holding_action_score.py is well-isolated, pure-Python, fully unit-tested (41 cases). No issues.

ACTION_THRESHOLDS list contains a redundant duplicate ('HOLD' for both >=75 and 60-75 buckets) — actual decision in map_has_to_action ignores the table and uses inline if/else. Suggest removing the unused ACTION_THRESHOLDS table or wiring it in to avoid drift between docs and behavior.
compute_has falls back to category='equity' silently when the supplied category is unknown — consider logging a warning so misspellings don't degrade silently.
Frontend filter chips render even when count=0 (e.g., 'Add · 0', 'Exit · 0'); good UX, no change needed.
DialogContent needs DialogTitle for accessibility — separate component issue, not HAS-specific.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing portfolio for priyankamantri (26 V3-bearing funds: 20 equity + 5 hybrid + 1 missing).
context_for_next_testing_agent: HAS feature is live and stable. The /api/insights/v3-portfolio endpoint returns portfolio.{avg_has_score, has_action_counts (ADD/HOLD/TRIM/SWITCH/EXIT/REVIEW/UNKNOWN), target_weight_pct_per_fund} and per-fund.has = {has, action, reason, category, components, ois_score, ads_score, ads_deviation_pp, tfs_penalty, guardrails, confidence}. Frontend mounts V3PortfolioInsights inside the 'Fund & Overlap Insights' sub-tab on /dashboard#insights. Reuse /app/backend/tests/test_v3_portfolio_has_api.py for regression. Pending-actions modal blocks initial nav — dismiss via 'Review Later' first. Endpoint is slow (~5s) — sleep ≥10s in playwright after clicking the sub-tab.
